title: NATIVELY running game on steam deck made with GPT 6 Astra and Higgsfield
author: CheesecakeOpening637
selftext:
I mean the deck wasn't supposed to be a game development tool but apparently curiosity didn't kill the cat. I used GPT 6 Astra for the game logic + design and it really does run natively on the deck not streamed or a web wrapper and Higgsfield for the visual assets.

Now I know AI at many aspects lacks creativity but still what it made isn't some basic prototype, the lighting and atmosphere look crazyyy, neon reflections on wet roads, city skyline, the entire midnight aesthetic bro higgsfield is straight up fire.

 

Anyway just wanted to share this here coz I've been really excited about it and also why not.
